subject: Wellington Station Multifamily Overlay District
overview: The board held a public hearing on a proposed zoning overlay around Wellington Station to comply with the state MBTA Communities Act, reviewing parking minimums, building heights, and development incentives before voting to continue the hearing to December 6, 2023. The board also approved past minutes and received department updates on upcoming development filings.

items.title: Wellington Station Multifamily Overlay District Hearing
items.summary: Planning staff presented a draft overlay district around the Wellington MBTA Orange Line station to zone for at least 6,443 multifamily housing units as required by Section 3A of MGL Chapter 40A, featuring baseline heights up to five stories and bonuses up to nine stories. Following board debate over parking minimums and maximums, height thresholds, and commercial incentives, the board voted to continue the hearing to December 6, 2023 for additional modeling data.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the draft minutes from September 6, 2023 and September 20, 2023.

items.title: Department Updates
items.summary: Staff briefed the board on upcoming site plan and planned development district filings, single-family permitting on the Windsor Street blasting site, and departmental recruitment for planning positions.
